title: Finite root projections are linear over the normalized completed coefficients
statement: For a prime l, a Noetherian scheme X with l invertible, and a coefficient isomorphism e with every finite-reduction normalization of [lem-diagonal-completed-coefficient-ring-comparison], fix n >= 0. The map from the root-tower limit to the underlying n-th bottom-field integral twist level, given by the root projection followed by the free-module unit, lifts to a morphism from purTwistZlModule restricted along e.hom to that finite level reconstructed as a Z_l module. The bottom field and its finite levels are those of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-diagrams], and reconstruction uses [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. No invertibility or limit of these finite morphisms is asserted.

source.place: Finite-level scalar calculation in paragraph (1) and the coordinatewise integral twist construction.

proof.text: The finite quotient coefficient ring B=O_E/l^(n+1) is annihilated by l^(n+1), since its defining ideal contains that scalar. This holds pointwise for continuous-function condensed sections and remains true after the additive inverse-image functor to X. Apply it to E=bottomField l.

The normalized reduction purZlReduction is the abelian-sheaf cokernel of multiplication by l^(n+1) on the pulled-back condensed Z_l ring. The actual coefficient map to B kills this multiplication, so the cokernel universal property gives a factor b from the constant cyclic residue sheaf to B. It is unital by the factorization equation. Cancel the epimorphism rho tensor rho in the multiplicativity equation to prove b is a ring-object homomorphism.

Reconstruct section rings and prove the constant-ring comparison, normalized on the sheafification unit, using the generic constant-presentation and ring-object APIs. Regard the free B-module on the finite root sheaf as a module over purTwistFiniteRing. The additive free-module unit from the finite root module is automatically linear over this constant cyclic ring: restrict to the constant presheaf, lift each ZMod scalar to an integer, use additivity, and descend via locally surjective restriction of scalars. Use the proved additive-to-linear helper abResidueLinearLift from the cyclic tensor comparison.

Apply he to e.hom(r), cancel e.hom followed by e.inv, and use the factorization rho followed by b equals the actual coefficient map. The result identifies the scalar acting through the finite root projection with the scalar acting on the target free B-module. The coordinate formula for purTwistZlAction and the finite-unit linearity now prove scalar compatibility of the prescribed root projection followed by the unit. Section reconstruction commutes with internal restriction of scalars by naturality of the lax monoidal comparison; apply it successively for Z_l to O_E and O_E to B.

The prescribed composite is already a natural additive sheaf morphism. Bundle its section maps and the proved scalar equations using PresheafOfModules.homMk. Forgetting the resulting module morphism is definitionally the required root projection followed by the free-module unit. No primitive-root generator or inverse to that unit is used; the same construction includes the empty scheme.

lean.statement:
theorem completedRootProjection_linear (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (hX : IsUnit (l : Γ(X, ⊤)))
    (e : (sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
          (InternalAbelianSheafModule.sectionRingSheaf.{u + 1, u + 1, u}
            (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
            (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} ℤ_[l]) X)) ≅
        Scheme.purTwistRing X (Scheme.purTwistZlCompletion X l))
    (he : ∀ n : ℕ,
        (sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
          (forget₂ RingCat.{u + 1} Ab.{u + 1})).map e.inv ≫
            (purZlReduction l X (n + 1)).hom =
          (sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
            (forget₂ RingCat.{u + 1} Ab.{u + 1})).map
              ((sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
                (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).map
                  (Scheme.purTwistZlProjection X l n)) ≫
            (sfbConstantRingAbIso X
              (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod (l ^ (n + 1)))))).hom)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ f : (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars e.hom).obj (Scheme.purTwistZlModule X l) ⟶
        (InternalAbelianSheafModule.sectionModuleEquivalence.{u + 1, u + 1, u}
          (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
          (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} ℤ_[l]) X)).functor.obj
            ((Mod.comap (coefficientMap (integralMap l (bottomField l)) X)).obj
              (spIntegralTwistLevel X l (bottomField l) n)),
      (SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).map f =
        limit.π (Scheme.proEtaleRootsOfUnityTower X l (Fact.out : l.Prime)) (op n) ≫
          (Mod.freeForgetAdjunction
            (condensedRingObj (spEllPointRingObj l (bottomField l) n) X)).unit.app
              (Scheme.proEtaleRootsOfUnitySheaf X (l ^ (n + 1)))
